jsonld.name: Ducks Kitchen
jsonld.description: Food truck in Clearwater, FL serving soul food, BBQ and made-to-order tacos since 2014.

parrafo.es: Ducks Kitchen es un food truck de Clearwater, FL que sirve comida sureña, BBQ y tacos desde 2014. Negocio local, identificado como propiedad de afroamericanos y de un veterano, con platos que sus clientes describen como frescos, llenos de sabor y hechos al momento.
parrafo.en: Ducks Kitchen is a Clearwater, FL food truck serving soul food, BBQ and tacos since 2014. A local, Black-owned and veteran-owned business, with plates customers describe as fresh, full of flavor and made to order.

hero.imagen_alt: Overhead view of a Ducks Kitchen plate with tacos, baked mac and cheese and dirty rice, next to a fresh drink pouch

parrafo_1.es: Ducks Kitchen es un food truck azul que atiende Clearwater, FL desde 2014. Comida sureña, BBQ y tacos, cocinados al momento y servidos con una sonrisa, según cuentan sus propios clientes en Google.
parrafo_1.en: Ducks Kitchen is a blue food truck serving Clearwater, FL since 2014. Soul food, BBQ and tacos, cooked to order and served with a smile, according to their own customers on Google.

parrafo_2.es: Es un negocio local identificado como propiedad de afroamericanos y de un veterano. Las reseñas mencionan los tacos una y otra vez, junto con el BBQ de fin de semana, el collard green gumbo y el trato directo de Duck y Ashley.
parrafo_2.en: It is a local business that identifies as Black-owned and veteran-owned. Reviews mention the tacos again and again, along with the weekend BBQ, the collard green gumbo and the direct, friendly service from Duck and Ashley.

texto.es: El truck atiende en Clearwater, FL. Llama para ubicación del día o para coordinar un catering.
texto.en: The truck serves Clearwater, FL. Call for the day's location or to set up catering.

texto.es: Tacos, BBQ o un plato sureño clásico: todo se cocina al momento con el menú del día.
texto.en: Tacos, BBQ or a classic soul food plate: everything is cooked to order off the day's menu.

texto.es: ¿Catering para tu evento? Cuéntanos cuántas personas y te damos el precio antes de reservar.
texto.en: Catering for your event? Tell us the headcount and we will give you a price before you book.

texto.es: Comida fresca, servida con trato directo. Así lo describen sus clientes desde 2014.
texto.en: Fresh food, served with direct, friendly service. That is how customers describe it since 2014.

nota.es: El menú cambia según el día. Para catering de eventos, escríbenos o llama y te damos el presupuesto sin compromiso.
nota.en: The menu changes by the day. For event catering, call or message us and we will give you a quote, no obligation.

texto.es: Los más mencionados en las reseñas: tortilla dorada, carne deshebrada, queso derretido y cilantro fresco.
texto.en: The most mentioned item in the reviews: griddled tortilla, shredded meat, melted cheese and fresh cilantro.

texto.es: Costillas ahumadas y bañadas en salsa, acompañadas de mac and cheese y frijoles horneados.
texto.en: Smoked ribs glazed in sauce, served with mac and cheese and baked beans.

texto.es: Pescado frito, collard green gumbo con cornbread, arroz sureño y mac and cheese horneado.
texto.en: Fried fish, collard green gumbo with cornbread, Southern dirty rice and baked mac and cheese.

texto.es: El truck también atiende eventos privados y reuniones. Cuéntanos la fecha y el número de invitados.
texto.en: The truck also caters private events and gatherings. Tell us the date and headcount.

pie.es: ¿Tienes un evento en mente? Llama y revisamos fecha, menú y presupuesto juntos.
pie.en: Have an event in mind? Call and we will go over date, menu and budget together.

items.quote: Duck and Ashley were absolutely amazing! As soon as we walked up- instant smiles. You can tell they love what thwy do! Ducks cooking skills- top tier. The food was so good and filling! Def will be getting them again!
Amazing food, amazing owner, amazing staff! I will be coming back many times! Can’t wait to try the BBQ on the weekends!

What an amazing spot! I tried the collared green gumbo with cornbread and it came loaded with meat, pleasantly spiced, and made to order! I was ecstatic when I ordered and the grill started firing instead of a 2 second exchange of ladle to …
I live right across the street. I have eaten their food quite a bit and I'm very happy they have moved over here! They are friendly and clean and the food is extremely flavorful!

Absolutely loved the food! Everything was fresh and flavorful and cooked perfectly. The tacos were delicious 😋😋 and filling. The service was friendly and you can tell they put a lot of care into what they do and serve.

texto.es: La forma más rápida de preguntar por el menú del día o coordinar un catering.
texto.en: The fastest way to ask about the day's menu or set up catering.

parrafo.es: Pregunta por el menú del día o cuéntanos de tu evento. Te damos el presupuesto antes de empezar.
parrafo.en: Ask about the day's menu or tell us about your event. We will give you a quote before you book.
